t: This is James Joyce Walk, a street in the London Borough of Lambeth, named after the Irish writer James Joyce. Joyce was a novelist, poet and critic, and is counted among the most influential writers of the twentieth century. His novel Ulysses, from 1922, follows the episodes of Homer's Odyssey in many different styles, including stream of consciousness. His other well-known works are the story collection Dubliners, A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man, and Finnegans Wake.
